summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a subscription agreement and non-binding financing package with Macquarie Bank Limited. Macquarie subscribed for C$10 million of common shares at C$4.26 per share, a 10% premium to the 5-day VWAP, alongside a C$300 million project finance facility term sheet (up to C$20 million capitalized interest) to fund the C$450 million Fenn-Gib initial development capital. The facility is secured by first-ranking project security, includes a C$25 million early drawdown, pays Adjusted Term CORRA plus 4.75% stepping down to 4.25%, and grants Macquarie an offtake over the first 50,000 oz annually up to 300,000 oz at a published reference price less US$50/oz, with 50% vesting now and 50% at facility close; Macquarie acts as Mandated Lead Arranger, Agent and Sole Underwriter and may syndicate at least 30%. This is a project financing and strategic equity investment rather than a special situation; watch facility conversion risk, syndication, and dilution/overhang from the equity subscription.
